description: A playlist of presets on the Eagan Matrix instrument, saved to a file of its own, so a set of favourites can be recalled in the order you choose; it works through a CHEM Core

inputs.text: A rising edge loads the preset before the current one in the list; it reads high above 5V and low below 0.1V
A rising edge loads the preset after the current one in the list; it reads high above 5V and low below 0.1V
A rising edge on a channel loads the preset at that position in the list, the first channel taking the first entry and 16 channels being the most that are read; it reads high above 5V

notes: nothing reaches the instrument until the module is linked to a CHEM Core; putting it beside a linked CHEM module links it, or click the link button at the bottom of the panel to pick a Core
a new module holds an empty list; the heart button adds the preset the instrument is playing, and the Append submenu on the hamburger menu brings in a whole scanned preset list
a modified playlist is never saved for you and you are never prompted, so save from the hamburger menu before closing the patch; the yellow lamp beside the playlist name shows unsaved changes
clicking an entry loads it, so to select one for moving or removing instead, hover the right edge of the entry and click the tab that appears; press and hold to drag it elsewhere
Rack takes the keys you would expect to use in a list, so Delete removes the module rather than the entry, and the arrow keys and paging keys do nothing here
menu: Track live preset — keeps the current entry in step with the preset the instrument is playing, scrolling the list to it when it is in the playlist
